title: Tracking off hides Min/Max and makes the bin optional, on needs a bin
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit". Open New Inventory Part.
custom_steps:
1. Turn the toggle OFF and check the Min and Max fields and the bin location section.
  2. Try to save with the toggle off and no bin.
  3. Turn the toggle ON and try to save with no bin marked default.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the toggle OFF the Min and Max fields are hidden and the bin location section stays visible but optional (a bin may be assigned for reference without being required to save).
  • With the toggle ON, at least one bin location must be assigned and marked as default before the part can be saved.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 4 (Create an untracked part); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R3: “When the user turns the toggle OFF, the Min and Max fields are hidden.”
  • S4-R4: “When the toggle is OFF, the bin location section remains visible but is optional, the user may assign a bin for physical reference without it being required to save.”
  • S4-R5: “When the toggle is ON, at least one bin location must be assigned and marked as default before the part can be saved.”
